title: Quick Smoky Chinese Tofu Quesadilla
description: A fusion Chinese-Mexican dish featuring smoky tofu, crunchy katsuramuki-cut vegetables, and creamy enchilada sauce, all wrapped in a crispy tortilla.

ingredients.name: katsuramuki-cut vegetables (such as cabbage, carrots, and bell peppers)

instructions: Cut the tofu into small cubes and marinate in a mixture of smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper for at least 15 minutes.
Heat 1 tsp of toasted sesame oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the katsuramuki-cut vegetables until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a separate pan, warm the tortillas over medium heat for about 30 seconds on each side.
Place one tortilla in the pan and sprinkle shredded tofu and cooked vegetables on half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook for about 2 minutes, until the tortilla is crispy and the filling is heated through.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients and serve hot with additional enchilada sauce on the side.
Cut the quesadilla into wedges and serve immediately.
